name: Metallic Dragon’s Diplomacy
body:
You have acquired the diplomatic abilities of the metallic dragons whose blood flows through your veins.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level dragon disciple, must have a metallic dragon bloodline

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks. In addition, once per day per three dragon disciple levels you possess, you are able to take 10 on a Diplomacy or Sense Motive check.
